note: Draft 1. Three remarks: 26:4b minor (plural 'delícias' → 'o prazer do Senhor'), refused; 26:9b MAJOR 'auxílio' → 'auxiliador', held (D19/D24, as in six earlier psalms); 26:13 MAJOR 'Creio que verei' → 'Creio ver', held ('Creio ver' is 'I think I see', a wrong first hearing). Marks confirmed.

outcomes.remark: 'delícias' pluralizes the singular voluptátem → 'o prazer do Senhor'
outcomes.reason: 'prazer' is heard first as the senses' and 25:3 has 'achei prazer' for complacére; number is grammar; 'a delícia' (singular) and his 'o prazer' are options.

outcomes.remark: adjútor is an agent → 'auxiliador'
present infinitive vidére made an explicit future → 'Creio ver'
outcomes.reason: Held: 'Creio ver' is heard as 'I think I see' (rule 2); the Greek τοῦ ἰδεῖν looks ahead; the stylist's best line; the blind reader heard it without doubt. His words an option.

note: Draft 1. Eight verses; best 26:13, worst 26:14. «Em alguns pontos, a sintaxe deixa ouvir o latim antes do português.» Five taken (26:1b, 26:3, 26:6b in substance, 26:10 in substance, 26:14 both remarks in part/whole), three refused with options (26:5, 26:11, 26:12).

outcomes.remark: 'de quem tremerei' is translated regência → 'diante de quem tremerei?'
subject late, two 'se' → 'Se um acampamento se postar contra mim'
outcomes.reason: Order taken, with 'se instalar' for the verb the blind reader did not know; 26:3b turned the same way.

outcomes.remark: 'no lugar escondido' provisional → 'no esconderijo'
'Rodeei' without object → 'Dei a volta'
outcomes.reason: Taken in substance with 'Andei ao redor' (intransitive, keeps circum-); 'Dei a volta' also 'I turned round', an option.

outcomes.remark: 'Porque … mas' → 'Pois … o Senhor, porém, me recolheu'
outcomes.reason: 'porém' after the subject taken (autem's place); 'Pois' refused, quóniam → porque.

outcomes.remark: 'Ponde uma lei para mim' not current → 'Estabelecei para mim uma lei'
outcomes.reason: 'estabelecer' is constitúere / statúere's (as refused at 24:12); the blind reader heard the sense.

outcomes.remark: second colon long → 'pois contra mim se ergueram'
outcomes.reason: quóniam → porque, insúrgere → levantar-se (glossary); the length is the Latin's.

outcomes.remark: 'varonilmente' bookish, 'porta-te' weak → 'age como homem'
outcomes.reason: 'como homem' taken; the verb 'portar-se' kept so 30:25 can follow ('Agi' = 'I acted'); 'age como homem' an option.

outcomes.remark: 'e fortaleça-se o teu coração' ceremonious → 'e que o teu coração se fortaleça'

note: Draft 1. 21 items, 8 unknown words (atribulam ×2, postar, imolei, vereda, iníquas, iniquidade, varonilmente). Wrong or doubtful first hearings: 26:6b 'uma vítima de aclamação' heard as a person harmed or sacrificed (kept — see hostiam: 'hóstia' is the Host, 'sacrifício' sacrifícium's); 26:14 'varonilmente' unknown and gendered (mended, 'como homem' — the Latin's vir); 26:3 'postar' unknown (mended, 'se instalar'). Heard rightly: 26:9 'com ira' as the Lord's anger; 26:10 'recolheu' as taking in (death a second hearing); 26:11 'give me a rule'; 26:13 'os bens' as blessings, 'terra dos vivos' as this life; 26:3 an enemy camp. Kept open as the Latin: 26:3b 'nisto', 26:8 what the heart said. Known costs: 26:12 'às almas' heard as spirits (ánima → alma).
